name: EXM_EXPENSE_PERDIEM_DETAILS
description: This table contains expense per diem details.

columns.name: EXPENSE_PERDIEM_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a per diem expense detail.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: EXPENSE_ID
columns.description: Per diem expense item to which a per diem expense detail belongs.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of a per diem trip, which may include start time depending on type of policy.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: End date of a per diem trip, which may include end time depending on type of policy.

columns.name: HOLIDAY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this per diem day in a trip is a holiday.

columns.name: PERDIEM_RATE
columns.description: Per diem rate for the day based on policy before deductions.

columns.name: PERDIEM_AMOUNT
columns.description: Per diem amount for the day based on policy before deductions.

columns.name: MEALS_DAILY_ALLOWANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Meals daily allowance amount for the day based on policy.

columns.name: MEALS_BREAKFAST_CODE
columns.description: Meals breakfast usage classification code used to calculate meals deduction or rate.

columns.name: MEALS_LUNCH_CODE
columns.description: Meals lunch usage classification code used to calculate meals deduction or rate.

columns.name: MEALS_DINNER_CODE
columns.description: Meals dinner usage classification code used to calculate meals deduction or rate.

columns.name: MEALS_ALLOWANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Meals allowance amount for this day in trip based on policy.

columns.name: FREE_MEALS_DEDUCT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Free meals deduction amount for this day in trip based on policy.

columns.name: FREE_ACCOM_DEDUCT_CODE
columns.description: Free accommodations deduction code for this day in trip based on policy.

columns.name: FREE_ACCOM_DEDUCT_AMOUNT
columns.description: Free accommodations deduction amount for this day in trip based on policy.

columns.name: ACCOM_ALLOWANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Accommodations allowance amount for this day in trip based on policy.

columns.name: ACCOM_ALLOWANCE_CODE
columns.description: Accommodations allowance code for this day in trip based on policy.

columns.name: INCID_ALLOWANCE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Incidentals allowance amount for this day in trip based on policy.

columns.name: LOCATION_ID
columns.description: Used to identify starting location of a leg in multiple destination trip.

columns.name: ZONE_CODE
columns.description: Zone code of a zone type for the starting location of a leg in multiple destination trip.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency in which the per diem rate is specified.

columns.name: NUM_OF_MEALS
columns.description: Number of meals used to calculate meals deduction or rate.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.
